comment: Declared volatile fields (docs/refactoring-policy.md). A field is masked only if it is declared here AND differs between the two base runs; everything else is compared exactly. '*' matches one array index only.

smoke-fleet.reason: time an offline printer was last checked

smoke-library-status.reason: time the Library's background hash finished

stepAttribution.reason: background lines (Library scan, warnings) land in whichever replay step is running; line content and count are still compared exactly, and [health] lines keep their step

linePatterns.regex: ^\[library\] scanned G-code folder: ok in (\d+\.\d) s —
linePatterns.reason: measured scan time; elapsed time cannot be made to vary on demand, so a declared duration is masked even when the two base runs happened to agree (reported every time)

process ID in Node's own runtime-warning prefix (e.g. the SQLite ExperimentalWarning); Node's internal threads share the PID range, so it can shift by one between runs. Only the number is masked; the warning text is compared exactly.
